title: Dataset and computer code for "The dynamics of cooperation in asymmetric public goods games"

equation_quality.supported_scope: See exact linked equations and parameter states; successful replay is not mechanism identification.

independent_units.independent_unit_description: Complete first-session interacting pair;20% hash heldout in each treatment; remaining groups in5 deterministic whole-pair folds. Both players remain together.

calibration_burden: One-step prediction before round3..20 using strictly prior own/peer contributions and publicly announced rules. Earlier confirmation responses are permitted causal online history, never fitted parameters. Surveys and session2 excluded.

baseline_strength.scope: Matched task/input access; historical controls are not claimed to exhaust state of the art.

practical_relevance.prediction_time: One-step prediction before round3..20 using strictly prior own/peer contributions and publicly announced rules. Earlier confirmation responses are permitted causal online history, never fitted parameters. Surveys and session2 excluded.
practical_relevance.claim_blockers: Transfer is restricted to the declared source and cohort; no measured deployment intervention.

promotion_conditions: Reassess only under a versioned contract; never rename exposed outcomes as fresh.

practical_use_contract.decision_or_analysis: Estimate Next-round individual contribution under the exact registered input budget
practical_use_contract.intended_user: Domain researcher or process analyst; operational adoption not demonstrated
practical_use_contract.inputs_available_when: One-step prediction before round3..20 using strictly prior own/peer contributions and publicly announced rules. Earlier confirmation responses are permitted causal online history, never fitted parameters. Surveys and session2 excluded.
practical_use_contract.calibration_requirement: One-step prediction before round3..20 using strictly prior own/peer contributions and publicly announced rules. Earlier confirmation responses are permitted causal online history, never fitted parameters. Surveys and session2 excluded.
practical_use_contract.calibration_cost: Not monetized or timed in the corpus; no zero-cost assumption
practical_use_contract.actionable_output: Next-round individual contribution in experimental tokens
practical_use_contract.failure_boundary: Transfer is restricted to the declared source and cohort; no measured deployment intervention.

default_numerical_evidence.lowest_error_interpretation: Retrospective description of all frozen alternatives, including attempts and possible aliases; not a new selection or independent baseline.

case_specific_next_evidence:
Prespecify a change-event task with scientifically meaningful token thresholds and report precision, recall, calibration and per-treatment errors alongside MAE.

Test whole-session/laboratory/treatment transfer on fresh pairs without repurposing exposed outcomes.

Separate descriptive forecasts from causal reciprocity or incentive-effect hypotheses requiring randomized contrasts.
